tool_args.rationale: The observed base field, sink gradient and coupled transient lag match the archived spatio-temporal siphon-memory mechanism. The trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to identify its parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter spatio-temporal siphon-memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately identify its five coupled parameters; the archived mechanism specifies at least eight rows.
The coupled transient-lag signature and variation with initial state support testing the dynamic mechanism first.
It is unrelated to the identified parameter ambiguity.
